Package domain

Class GameCharacter

java.lang.Object
domain.GameCharacter
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class GameCharacter extends Object implements Serializable
A character: a country (a team) with a power shot. There are 8 teams sharing the 4 power shots of Annex 1; the 4 countries of the Annex use their own shot. A character has no stats: stats belong to the player. Some characters are locked and are bought in the store.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Elian Ibarra, Oscar Poveda
